profile.headline: Software Engineer at IXL Learning
profile.summary:
Recent Stanford graduate with academic focus on complexity theory and cryptography, and a variety of interests and experiences.
Skilled in composition, jazz piano, software engineering, mathematical reasoning, and teaching.
Passionate about piano, music composition, mathematics, education, cybersecurity, animation, cryptography, and more.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Hosted a Stellar (blockchain) test server.
Helped with backend and full-stack programming projects including API development and homepage development.
Helped the team to host the API and database using AWS EC2 and RDS instances.
Made various bots with python to mediate content, gather statistics, and run games on the company's public telegram chat group.

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
CA for courses in Algorithms (CS161), Cryptography (CS255), and Complexity Theory (CS154).
Lead sections of up to 20 students, held office hours to guide struggling students, and contributed to class material including homework assignments and exam questions.

company.name: Stanford University Department of Computer Science

positions.title: SUMO Math Tutor
positions.description: Individually tutored Stanford students in linear algebra and multivariable calculus.

positions.title: Digital Instrument Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed parameter editing programs (VST Plugins) in C++ for physical modeling systems.
Researched the effects of various parameters on instrument sound.
Contributed to development of a new digital piano.

positions.title: American Language and Culture Coordinator
positions.description:
Helped college students from Japan, China, and Taiwan learn and practice English.
Led groups of foreign students on cultural activities in the Bay Area.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Lead a group of volunteers in providing free piano lessons to underprivileged Redwood City elementary school students. 
Managed leadership structure and finances/budget.
